# Harbor Telemetry Exchange Format

Internal specification memo, prepared for the Harbor Systems working group.

## Front matter

The full title of this specification is Harbor Telemetry Exchange Format.
This document describes version 2.1 of the format.
Its current status is Internal Draft.
The editors are Priya Raman, Tomas Lindqvist and Aiko Brennan.

This specification was published on 14 March 2026.

## Summary

The format defines a line-oriented envelope for buoy and berth sensor readings.
Each record carries a station identifier, a UTC timestamp and a typed payload.

## Change log

- Clarified payload length limits.
- Added the checksum trailer.

## Distribution note

Per the registry entry circulated to members, this specification was published on 21 March 2026.
